items.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
items.summary: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
items.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident
items.creator: Russell Brandom
